answer: Counterparty diversity rule: an identity may transact after dealing with 8 unrelated counterparties, blocking bulk forgeries. It posts a bond; partners must not form one cluster, like karst water seeping through channels. Rewards start nectar-small and grow as diverse partners vouch. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds and 800 ties, about 50,000 credits, while one honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards as a gale of fakes flood in.
